Steps 18-20 immediately rebuild and repeat the same Account settings menu → Development → Your applications → Back cycle. The same navigation mechanism remains visible through steps 47-50, with no database-size value obtained, no correction to the route premise, and no toot containing an MB result visibly posted.

summary: The sole frozen strict-MHR chain visibly repeats a contradicted Back-navigation premise and remains in an uninterrupted Account settings/Development/Your applications loop through the last trace step. No database-size result or corresponding owner-account toot is observable.
